::: {#def-simulation-estimate}
#### Simulation estimate

A **simulation estimate** of the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation) $\E{T}$ of an [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $T$
is the average of the [replications](#def-replication)' [estimates](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $T_1, \ldots, T_M$:

$$\bar T_M \eqdef \frac{1}{M} \sumto{m}{M} T_m.$$

For an [estimand](estimation.qmd#def-estimand) $\param$,
the simulation estimate of the [bias](estimation.qmd#def-bias) of $\hparam$ is $\bar T_M - \param$.
The simulation estimate of its [mean squared error](estimation.qmd#def-mse) is the average of $(T_m - \param)^2$.
:::
